# Swap USDC

> Swap USDC is a non-custodial interface for swapping USDC for ETH, USDT, WETH or any ERC-20 token on Ethereum, and back, through DEX routing. Users connect their own wallet, review the quote and sign each transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- USDC is a dollar stablecoin issued by Circle and is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum.
- Swaps are routed through DEX liquidity and priced by the market, including USDC to USDT.
- Gas is paid in ETH, and USDC needs a one-time ERC-20 approval before the first swap from a wallet.
- Some Layer 2 networks have both native USDC and bridged USDC.e, which are different contracts.
- The interface is non-custodial: it never holds funds or keys, and the user signs every transaction.
